cycles.legacy_note: Created before report_cycles schema 2; no retrospective snapshot was fabricated.

recovery_assessment.recommendation: Recuperación prioritaria; evitar cargas máximas y reevaluar sueño, síntomas y calentamiento.

sleep_integrity.policy: Body Battery sleep events are candidates only; never add to confirmed Garmin sleep.

training_guidance.note: Guidance only; no direct measure of neuromuscular readiness, and sleepiness can affect coordination independently of muscle fatigue.

heart_rate_3d.note: Daytime rolling excludes partial days; nighttime rolling may include the current completed sleep window.

heart_rate_7d.note: Daytime rolling excludes partial days; nighttime rolling may include the current completed sleep window.

heart_rate_28d.note: Daytime rolling excludes partial days; nighttime rolling may include the current completed sleep window.

readiness_model.intensity_guidance: Señales de recuperación desfavorables: evita intensidad máxima y evalúa síntomas.
readiness_model.note: V2.2: score compatible, no indicador fisiológico independiente. Para decidir usar recovery_assessment_v2.state, status y confidence.

readiness_hybrid.note: V2.2: score compatible, no indicador fisiológico independiente. Para decidir usar recovery_assessment_v2.state, status y confidence.
readiness_hybrid.intensity_guidance: Señales de recuperación desfavorables: evita intensidad máxima y evalúa síntomas.

readiness_hybrid.note: V2.2: score compatible, no indicador fisiológico independiente. Para decidir usar recovery_assessment_v2.state, status y confidence.
readiness_hybrid.intensity_guidance: Señales de recuperación desfavorables: evita intensidad máxima y evalúa síntomas.

convergence_alert.rule: Alerts require converging signals and at least 7 historical observations per metric. HRV/sleep/resting/night HR use fused recovery history; stress/body battery/recovery time retain Advanced Analytics sources. Thresholds are unchanged and isolated changes are not diagnostic.
convergence_alert.aggregation_rule: Severity is based on independent physiological domains, not raw metric count. Sleep duration + sleep score count once; resting HR + night HR count once; stress + Body Battery count once. Signal thresholds are unchanged.

weekly_load.note: Monotony/strain are contextual training-load descriptors, not medical thresholds.

rpe_feedback.policy: Intervals RPE has priority when present; external feedback fills missing RPE. Differences >=0.5 are reported.

recovery_baseline_policy.note: Recovery-sensitive signals still use fused history with the same thresholds, but convergence severity is now based on independent domains so correlated metrics are not double-counted. Recovery Score and Hybrid Readiness scoring are unchanged.

data_quality.scope_note: No activity for 3+ days may reflect rest; freshness of Garmin raw measurements is not verified from this summary alone.

weekly_report.recorded_srpe_note: Only recorded duration x RPE; not equivalent to effective WOD duration, and not comparable with TRIMP.

readiness_latest.note: V2.2: score compatible, no indicador fisiológico independiente. Para decidir usar recovery_assessment_v2.state, status y confidence.
readiness_latest.intensity_guidance: Señales de recuperación desfavorables: evita intensidad máxima y evalúa síntomas.

weekly_report.recommendation: Interpret trends cautiously; compare only equivalent workouts and consider shift-work and subjective symptoms.

activities_today.name: HIIT

manual_blocks.notes: 21-15-9 de sentadilla frontal 60 kg y handstand push-ups; 45 repeticiones de cada ejercicio (90 en total). Completado con time cap 8 min; Garmin 8:31 grabados. RPE 8,5.

detail_json.notes: Completado dentro del time cap de 8 min según atleta; duración grabada Garmin 8 min 31 s, no igual al tiempo exacto de finalización.

activities_today.srpe_caveat: Duración grabada; no equivale necesariamente al tiempo efectivo del WOD.

activities_today.name: Fuerza

manual_blocks.notes: 10 series de 2: 60, 80, 110, 140, 150, 155, 160, 165, 167,5 (interpretación del dictado) y 170 kg. Series 1-6 cada 60 s; series 7-10 cada 75 s. Garmin 15:20.

detail_json.notes: Serie 9 interpretada como 167,5 kg a partir del dictado; no confirmada independientemente.

activities_today.srpe_caveat: Duración grabada; no equivale necesariamente al tiempo efectivo del WOD.
